title: Collection
description: A collection, a type of content: its name, the address prefix its entries live under (/<prefix>/<entry>), its fields, and the order its entries are listed in by default; and, under $defs, an entry and the value each type of field holds. Which value belongs to which field depends on the collection, which is data: application rules, written once in TypeScript (schema/tools/collection-rules.ts) and once in Ruby (cms/lib/collection_document/rules.rb), give each value of an entry to the definition of its field's type here, and say what this file cannot (schema/README.md lists them).
$comment: Written to the rules of block-document.schema.json, and linted with it: dispatch is if/then on the type const, never oneOf; patterns use only explicit ASCII classes and \u escapes. A value reuses the page document's own definitions: a rich text is the text widget's document, an image the image widget's library image, a link the button's label and address. No $id: the references to block-document.schema.json are relative, so each reader resolves them beside this file (json_schemer from the file, the API description's linter from its folder), and ajv, which needs a name, is given this file under https://page-builder-cms.example/schema/collection.schema.json, beside the page schema's $id.

name.description: What the editor calls the collection (News, Events).

prefix.description: The first part of every entry's address: news for /news/<entry>. Unique among the collections and never a page's address, nor one the application answers itself: the CMS's rules, outside this file.

fields.description: The fields every entry of the collection has, in the order the editor shows them, beside the built-in title and slug. Keys unique in the collection: an application rule.

slug.description: An address, or a part of one, as a page's: lowercase letters and digits in words joined by single hyphens, at most 64 characters.

fieldKey.description: The key a field's value is kept under in every entry: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter, as an anchor; never title or slug, the built-in fields every entry has.

fieldType.description: text: one line; paragraph: plain lines; richText: the text widget's document; number: with an optional lowest and highest value, two decimals at most; date: a day; image: a library image with its alt text, or decorative; link: a button's label and address; toggle: true or false; choice: one of the field's options.

field.description: One field: its key, what the editor calls it, its type, whether an entry must give it a value; for a number its lowest and highest value, each optional, and for a choice its options.

min.description: The lowest value a number may have, two decimals at most (an application rule), and never above max (another).

max.description: The highest value a number may have, two decimals at most (an application rule).

options.description: What a choice may be, in the order the editor offers them: one to twenty, each once (an application rule).

field.$comment: One if/then per type, on min, max and options, with the same 'properties: {x: true}' beside each 'required' as the page schema's imageRules, for ajv's strictRequired.

rangeOrOptions.description: Used under 'not': a field that names a lowest or highest value, or options, which only a number and a choice take.

sort.description: The order the entries are listed in when nothing else is asked for: by title, by when they were last changed (updatedAt), by when they went live (publishedAt), or by the key of one of the collection's date or number fields (an application rule); ascending or descending.

entry.description: One entry of a collection as the editor saves it: its title, its address in the collection, and its values by field key. Each value is checked by the application rules against its field: there is one for each key, a value for each required field, and each one is of its field's type (the definitions below).

textValue.description: One line of plain text with a visible character, at most 200 characters.

paragraphValue.description: Plain text that may break its lines, with a visible character, at most 5000 characters.

richTextValue.description: The text widget's own document: paragraphs, line breaks, lists, and bold, italic and link marks.

numberValue.description: A number from minus a billion to a billion, with two decimals at most (an application rule), within its field's own lowest and highest values (another).

dateValue.description: A day, written YYYY-MM-DD. That the day exists (no 30 February) is an application rule.

imageValue.description: An image of the media library, by its id, with its alt text, or marked decorative: the image widget's own rules, with no image from another site.

linkValue.description: A button's label and where it goes, by the link rules of a page.

choiceValue.description: One line of plain text with a visible character, at most 60 characters: an option of a choice, and the value an entry gives it, which must be one of its field's options (an application rule).
